svg.text: Stage B: final perfboard (5 x 7 cm, 18 x 24 holes)
Parts sit on the TOP. Wires run on the BOTTOM and are soldered there. Every hole is isolated: only solder and wire join things.
GND to GND ... SDA to SDA
left and right are swapped: column R is now on the left
Grey bars at N23-M23 and N24-M24: C3's legs bent over onto the header pins.
C24 (VIN) gets no wire. Grey squares: pin stubs with nothing soldered to them except the header itself.
servo GND bus, 0.5 mm2 (20 AWG): B2 D2 F2 H2 J2 L2 O2 R2
servo +5 V bus, 0.5 mm2 (20 AWG): B3 D3 F3 H3 J3 L3 O4 R4
ground join and OLED GND, 0.2 mm2 (24 AWG)
Wires lie flat on the bottom and are soldered only at their two ends,
onto the pin stub that pokes through (lap joint). Insulated wire may
cross other wires and pads; a bare end must touch only its own pin.
Bus wires are short pieces, pin to pin, in the order listed.
VIN (C24) stays empty: the ESP32 runs from its own USB cable.
Before any power: meter on beep, red probe R4, black R2: no beep.
